$comment: Balance-workbench parameter registry (sweep.py validates knobs and ranges against this file). MEASUREMENT ONLY: sweeps inject values at sim runtime and never touch data files or shipped constants — a winning value gets committed as the real constant/data afterwards, at which point the baseline ceremony (INVARIANTS #9) applies. ADDING A KNOB (the pattern): (1) if the value lives on enemy STATES, teach sim_runner._resolve_tuning/_apply_state_scalars a new key (state_scalar kind); (2) if it lives in the ENGINE, replace the constant/inline read in combat_manager with _tuned_int/_tuned_float("your_key", SHIPPED_VALUE) — defaults MUST be the shipped value so an empty tuning dict is byte-identical (ci_smoke proves it); (3) declare it here with id, kind, scope, path, default, range; (4) run ci_smoke (zero drift) and tests/sim_determinism.sh.

knobs.scope: per_op (use key@op, e.g. enemy_hp_scalar@hive) or global
knobs.path: sim_runner._apply_state_scalars — enemy max_hp/current_hp at spawn and on summons (round, min 1)
knobs.notes: Multiplies every enemy HP pool in runs on the qualified op. Data law (enemy HP multiple of 5) applies only to AUTHORED values; swept pools may land off-grid.

knobs.path: sim_runner._apply_state_scalars — enemy state dmg_scale at spawn and on summons
knobs.notes: Multiplies enemy ability damage via the existing dmg_scale state field (rounded per hit by the engine).
